description: On the tabletop in front there’s a blue bowl, a gray plastic bin on the right, a yellow toy animal, a small bird figurine, and a few wooden blocks. The left hand stays low and open near the left side, while the right hand reaches into the gray bin, grasps a small red piece as a right-hand object, lifts it out, moves left toward the blue bowl, drops the red piece into the bowl, and then withdraws back to the right.
